meta.guardrail_pack: GCC Perishable & Cold-Storage Guardrails for AI Agents
meta.precedence: This overlay takes precedence over the base file on any conflict. Base rules GCC-EDGE-001..020 and GCC-NORM-001..005 remain in force unless explicitly overridden here.

derived_from.worked_vertical: finfish_seafood (chilled), extended to all chilled 0-5 C and frozen <= -18 C perishables

meta.disclaimer: Operational guardrails for agent design. Not legal advice. Penalty figures and procedures change; verify at source before enforcement.

rules.title: SFDA rapid warning system triggers on risk, not on confirmed harm

legal_basis.instrument: Food Law, Royal Decree No. M/1 (1436 AH); SFDA rapid warning system for direct or indirect risks to human health; SFDA powers to inspect, sample, close facilities, suspend production lines and withdraw food

signals: product already released from the port

agent_must: Treat the rapid warning threshold as a potential risk to public health, not a proven one
Draft the notification and assemble the distribution list; escalate for human transmission
Recognise SFDA as the single competent authority across the whole food chain - there is no separate federal/local split as in the UAE
agent_must_not: Wait for laboratory confirmation before escalating
Notify a municipal authority instead of SFDA and treat that as discharge of the duty
rules.escalation: Immediate human escalation; agent drafts, human transmits.

rules.title: FASEH release is a gate the agent cannot substitute for

legal_basis.instrument: Food Law Article 7 - imported food shall not be released prior to SFDA approval; SFDA Conditions and Requirements for Importing Food, Article 5 (SFDA procedures)
legal_basis.authority: SFDA; ZATCA for customs release after SFDA clearance

trigger.expression: consignment is imported AND FASEH release status is not confirmed released
signals: agent asked whether the load 'looks fine to move'

agent_must: State that no imported consignment may be released prior to SFDA approval, regardless of how good the telemetry looks
Report FASEH status as a distinct field from telemetry verdict
Treat an in-spec log as evidence supporting clearance, never as clearance
agent_must_not: Recommend gate-out on telemetry alone
Interpret ZATCA customs progress as SFDA food clearance
Advise moving a consignment held pending SFDA decision
rules.escalation: Hard block on any release recommendation before confirmed SFDA release.

rules.title: Health certificate must match the physical consignment after a cold-chain event

legal_basis.instrument: SFDA import conditions Articles 3 and 5 - health certificates must follow the SFDA or GSO model and be issued by the competent authority of the exporting country; SFDA designs the standard certificate models and may audit the exporting country's competent authority under Article 8

trigger.expression: consignment split, transferred, partially salvaged or re-consolidated following an excursion
signals: part of the load moved to a substitute reefer
consignment split across two clearance entries

agent_must: Flag that any split, transfer or repack breaks the one-certificate-to-one-consignment correspondence
Require certificate reconciliation before proposing any onward movement
Verify the certificate follows the current SFDA or GSO model, not an annexed model from an older edition of the import guide
agent_must_not: Assume a certificate covers a reconstituted or partially salvaged consignment
Reuse a certificate reference across a split
Rely on the certificate models annexed to an undated import guide as current
rules.escalation: hold_for_qa pending SFDA position on the split.

rules.title: Halal certification chain must survive the salvage decision

legal_basis.instrument: SFDA Halal Center recognition of Halal Certification Bodies; certificate of consignment for halal slaughter (meat, poultry, birds) and certificate of consignment for halal products; adopted GSO 2055-1

trigger.expression: salvage, transfer or co-storage following a cold-chain failure on a halal-relevant consignment
signals: substitute reefer with unknown prior load

agent_must: Confirm that the halal certificate was issued by a body recognised by the SFDA Halal Center - an unrecognised body's certificate has no standing regardless of its content
Treat halal segregation as a separate pass/fail dimension from temperature
Verify which of the three certificate types applies: consignment halal slaughter, consignment halal products, or establishment-level halal certificate
agent_must_not: Accept a halal certificate from a body not recognised by the SFDA Halal Center
Treat successful temperature recovery as curing a segregation break
rules.escalation: reject the halal claim and escalate.

rules.title: No re-dating or relabelling; menu-level disclosure is also in scope

legal_basis.instrument: Adopted GSO 9 date marking - producer-applied indelible dates only, no stickers, one date per pack; SFDA menu labelling technical regulation in force from 1 July 2025
legal_basis.authority: SFDA; Ministry of Municipalities and Housing for food service premises

trigger.expression: proposal to alter a date or label after an excursion, OR excursion affects product destined for a food service establishment subject to menu labelling

agent_must: Refuse all date and label alteration, including shortening
Note that for food service destinations, an excursion affecting composition or portioning can also invalidate declared menu nutrition, caffeine or sodium information
Route any legitimate re-dating need to SFDA through a named human
agent_must_not: Propose a date sticker
Assume menu labelling obligations are unaffected by a product substitution made during salvage

rules.title: Penalty exposure is set by a schedule that changes - do not quote stale figures

legal_basis.instrument: Food Law (M/1) penalty chapter plus the joint SFDA / Ministry of Municipalities and Housing schedule of food law violations, updated in 2025. SFDA enforcement powers include facility closure, production line suspension and seizure.

trigger.expression: agent is asked to state penalty exposure OR to auto-release against an unresolved excursion

agent_must: State that penalty amounts are set in a periodically updated violations schedule and must be read from the current schedule
Escalate to a named human for any release against the agent's proposal
Report the enforcement powers (closure, line suspension, seizure) as the operative risk rather than quoting a figure
agent_must_not: Quote a specific fine figure from memory or from an undated document
Release autonomously

rules.title: Cite the current SFDA statute, not the 2007 Act

legal_basis.instrument: A new Law of the Saudi Food and Drug Authority was enacted in 2025, superseding the Food and Drug Authority Act (Royal Decree M/6 of 1428 AH). The 2025 Law grants SFDA legal personality with financial and administrative independence, reporting to the President of the Council of Ministers, and consolidates regulatory, executive and monitoring mandates.

trigger.expression: agent generates a legal citation for a Saudi cold-chain decision

agent_must: Cite the Food Law (Royal Decree M/1, 1436 AH) as the substantive food statute and the 2025 SFDA Law as the authority statute
Flag that the exact royal decree number of the 2025 SFDA Law is unverified in the sibling profile and should be confirmed on laws.boe.gov.sa or in the Umm Al-Qura gazette
Check the SFDA regulations register for the current edition of any technical regulation cited
agent_must_not: Cite Royal Decree M/6 of 1428 AH as the current SFDA statute
Cite a technical regulation edition without checking the register

rules.title: Arabic narrative parsing and bilingual certificate reconciliation

legal_basis.instrument: SFDA health certificate models are bilingual Arabic/English; adopted GSO 9 requires Arabic labelling

trigger.expression: artifact language is ar_msa OR a bilingual certificate is in evidence
signals: Arabic and English certificate fields that do not correspond

agent_must: Apply base rules GCC-EDGE-008 and GCC-EDGE-011 to Arabic hedge words exactly as to English ones
Reconcile the Arabic and English fields of a bilingual certificate and report any divergence as a documentation defect
Quote both language versions verbatim where they diverge
agent_must_not: Read only the English half of a bilingual certificate
Round or reformat numbers during translation
Treat a divergence between the Arabic and English fields as a translation artefact rather than a defect
rules.escalation: hold_for_qa on any certificate field divergence.

rules.title: Normal Saudi clearance path

trigger.expression: base GCC-NORM-001 or GCC-NORM-002 satisfied AND FASEH released AND halal certification from an SFDA-recognised body AND health certificate on the current model

agent_must: Report telemetry verdict, FASEH status, halal certificate body recognition and health certificate model as four separate confirmations
Cite Food Law Article 7 and the SFDA import conditions
agent_must_not: Collapse the four confirmations into a single 'cleared' statement

rules.title: Saudi record and citation contract
agent_must: Cite the specific article of the Food Law or the specific SFDA technical regulation relied on
Record the FASEH reference and the halal certificate reference in the traceability write-back
Retain the raw telemetry artifact unmodified
agent_must_not: Cite 'SFDA regulations' generically without an instrument reference
